messages:
Aria: CI on main is red — integration-linux-matrix failing on checksum test. can someone retrigger just that matrix without rebuilding images? I want to avoid a full rebuild :grimacing:
Sam: yep. use our rerun endpoint to target the matrix axis. e.g.

Sam: ```
/ci rerun --job integration-linux --axis matrix --no-image
``` 
Sam: that preserves docker image cache and only re-executes the test slice. if you're using GH checks you can also run `gh workflow run` with inputs but the internal /ci is quicker here.
Aria: sweet, will try. does that preserve the build artifact volume?
Sam: yes, it reuses workspace volumes by default. if you need to force keep-the-venv do `--keep-venv`.
DevOpsBot: Build 87912 queued by Sam for job integration-linux (no-image). ETA ~2m.
Leo: if it flakes repeatedly, consider bisecting. quick bisect steps: 1) rerun a narrowed git range locally; 2) run the failing shard with `--focus 'TestChecksum'`; 3) if still green, try a few PRs in the middle. or ask infra to run `ci bisect --shard integration-linux --test TestChecksum`.
Maria: i pushed a tiny env fix to the PR linked in the original failure. can we trigger from the PR without pushing more commits?
Sam: yes, comment `@ci rerun --shard=integration-linux --no-image` on the PR and the bot will pick it up. or run the same `/ci` command in #ci-commands if you don't want a PR comment.
Aria: did the rerun pass? :crossed_fingers:
DevOpsBot: Build 87912 completed — SUCCESS. :tada:
Aria: awesome, thanks all :raised_hands:
Leo: note for next time — when calling `--no-image` include `--keep-cache` if you're using ephemeral runners.
Maria: saved me a rebuild. will add the note in the contrib docs.
Sam: added a short snippet to our wiki: https://redwood.internal/ci/retriggers :thumbsup:
